sections.content: LifestyleRx is a precision lifestyle medical practice, combining medical expertise with a team-based approach including one-to-one and group medical visits, nutritional coaching, education, and digital tracking. We are currently looking for a Registered Dietitian to join our team.

sections.heading: Responsibilities will include:
sections.content:
Working collaboratively with a physician-led health team.
Completing Nutrition Assessments using the LifestyleRx tools and systems.
Meeting with individuals via telephone or video calls from home.
Creating nutrition goals with individuals and providing ongoing support and accountability in cooperation with a health-care team.
Scheduling nutrition and coaching sessions.
Documenting appointments in our electronic medical records system.
Monitoring digital tracking used with individual health programs.
General help involved while working in a clinic setting.

sections.heading: You are a person who:
sections.content:
Loves healthy food and is passionate about sharing a healthy lifestyle with others.
Is compassionate and understanding of a variety of individual health needs and life situations.
Has knowledge of whole foods, exercise, sleep and stress management habits.
Has skills and techniques to support others in adopting healthy nutrition, lifestyle habits and goal setting.
Has experience working with diverse populations.
Is flexible and excited to be part of growing health movement.
Is comfortable with technology and willing to learn and adapt to multiple systems.

sections.heading: Qualifications include:
sections.content:
Registered Dietitian 
Experience working in a clinic or health-care setting.
Experience working collaboratively with a health-care team.

sections.heading: What we offer:
sections.content:
100% remote working environment.
Competitive compensation, based on education and experience.
